All three readers have finished and recorded their usages. I did not run a final `list_recorded_usages` pass, so I haven't checked for duplicates or confirmed the SDK versions. Versions are manifest ranges because there is no lockfile.

**Model and LLM providers (`src/libs/agent-runtime`)**
- **OpenAI SDK:** the shared `LobeOpenAICompatibleFactory` handles chat, models, embeddings, text-to-image and text-to-speech.
- **OpenAI-compatible providers (about 38):** these go through the same factory. They include DeepSeek, Groq, Mistral, Moonshot, Qwen, Zhipu, xAI, Perplexity, Together AI and others.
- **Direct SDK or HTTP providers:**
  - Anthropic
  - Google Gemini and Vertex AI
  - AWS Bedrock
  - Ollama
  - Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Inference
  - Cloudflare Workers AI
  - Hugging Face
  - OpenRouter
- **Speech:** the TTS and STT routes call OpenAI, and the Edge and Azure TTS routes use `@lobehub/tts`.

**Other external services**
- **Observability and analytics:**
  - Langfuse
  - Sentry
  - PostHog
  - Vercel Analytics, Speed Insights and Edge Config
  - Google Analytics
  - Umami (script include)
- **Storage:**
  - AWS S3, through the file service wrapper.
  - Cloudflare R2, in the CDN workflow script.
- **Auth:**
  - Clerk, as an SDK and as a Svix-signed webhook receiver.
  - Logto webhook, using an HMAC check.
  - Casdoor webhook, using a shared secret.
  - WeChat OAuth.
  - Operator-configured next-auth OIDC providers, including Entra ID.
- **Crawling, search and documents:**
  - Jina, Search1API and Browserless for crawling.
  - SearXNG at an operator-configured host.
  - Unstructured for document parsing.
- **Content and registry hosts:**
  - `registry.npmmirror.com` for the agents index and version check.
  - `chat-plugins.lobehub.com` and `chat-agents.lobehub.com` for plugin and agent indexes.
  - `raw.githubusercontent.com` for changelogs and the compose installer.
  - The GitHub REST API in `.github/scripts/pr-comment.js`.
  - npmmirror configuration lines in the three Dockerfiles.

**Gaps and uncertainties**
- **OpenAI-compatible providers:** these were recorded from their base URLs and the shared factory call, not by reading each provider file.
- **Second base URLs:** Cohere, Together AI, SenseNova and Zhipu set a second base URL for non-chat endpoints. Those calls are not recorded.
- **Vertex hint:** the `aiplatform.googleapis.com` host hint was accepted but never seen in code.
- **Missing CI workflows:** `.github` has no `workflows/` folder in this checkout, so any calls made from CI are unknown.
- **`PROXY_URL`:** read in `scripts/serverLauncher/startServer.js`, but nobody traced where it is used.
- **User-supplied URLs, not recorded:**
  - Plugin gateway calls (`src/services/chat.ts:391` posts to `manifest.gateway`, which comes from the plugin manifest).
  - The proxy route at `src/app/(backend)/webapi/proxy/route.ts`.
  - `imageToBase64`.
  - `toolManifest`.
  - The web-crawler `naive` implementation.
- **Own backend, not recorded:** `trpc/client/lambda.ts:13` fetches the app's own backend.
- **Left out as a database driver:** the Neon serverless driver in `src/database`.
- **Left out as user-configured:** y-webrtc sync connects to a signaling server the user configures.
